limitations: Reader only: the Agent searches, reads and bookmarks. It cannot post, reply, repost, like, follow or send direct messages; public posts enter only through the seed or Infra's post.publish.

One image: a rendered PNG with alt text. Agent byte reads of it need a platform resource-access registration that this package does not add; the alt text carries the visible text, so tasks run on text reads.
post.publish carries text and link cards, not images. A post's publication time is the event time.
No live ingestion: every account, post and link is a synthetic fixture on the reserved .example domain; nothing is fetched.
One reader account per App instance. The public history is copied into each instance, so Infra applies every post.publish event to every reader instance in the run.
Search matches the start of words (case- and accent-insensitive); there is no ranking, recommendation or trending.
Wirewalk neither publishes nor receives cross-App notifications; alerts are drafted and sent with Mail.
MCP only: no GUI and no reviewer console.
